item.title: Murakami: Samurai Streets & Centuries-Old Salted Salmon — Guide
item.description: Murakami, a former castle town roughly an hour north of Niigata City, retains a well-preserved historic streetscape of samurai residences and merchant houses dating back to the Edo period. The town is equally famous for its centuries-old relationship with salmon, historically the first in Japan to practise sustainable salmon fishery management, and its distinctive salt-curing tradition, where whole salmon are hung to dry under the eaves of specialist shops each winter, creating an unmistakable seasonal streetscape.
